meaning: The national flag of Ghana — red for the blood of those who died for independence, gold for mineral wealth, green for the forests
note: Designed by Theodosia Salome Okoh and flown from independence in 1957. The black star at its centre stands for African emancipation.
references: Permanent Mission of Ghana to the United Nations — “Ghana Flag & Coat of Arms”, https://www.ghanamissionun.org/ghana-flag/
